name: Amatrice (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Amatrice (a white cross on red) within branches, with the inscription CITTA' DELL'AMATRICE in yellow arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Amatrice, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Amatrice arms — white cross on red, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTA' DELL'AMATRICE arched above the arms
